title: The Martyrdom of Justin and His Companions
author: Acts of the Martyrs
edition: Migne PG 6 (1857), cols. 1565-1572 (recension B, 'Ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῶν ἀνόμων ὑπερμάχων'), assembled from two archive.org scans and checked against Gebhardt, Acta martyrum selecta (1902) and Knopf, Ausgewählte Märtyrerakten (1913, text after Otto 1879)

text_history.method: New English from the Greek copy-text. The copy-text is Migne's print (PG 6.1565-1572), read line by line from the scan page images and the OCR of two independent scans of the volume, with every word checked against two later independent prints of the same recension (Gebhardt 1902; Knopf 1913, whose text follows Otto 1879). Each word stands where at least two witnesses agree; OCR errors were corrected and Migne's wording kept, with one misprint corrected (see assembly). No published English used as wording.

assembly.what: Recension B of the Acts of Justin assembled word by word. Witnesses: M1 and M2 = OCR of two independent archive.org scans of Migne PG 6 (one print); the Greek column of scan B was also read line by line from the page images; G = Gebhardt 1902; K = Knopf 1913 (text after Otto 1879; its OCR keeps letters but not accents). G and K print the same recension, so they count as independent witnesses to the wording. Rule: a word stands where at least two witnesses agree; Migne's wording is kept where Migne differs from G and K as an edition (listed under edition_differences), OCR errors are corrected, and the one Migne misprint is corrected. Removed: footnote markers (66)-(80), Migne's margin letters A-D, chapter numerals, line-end hyphens. Chapters follow Migne's numbering I-V.
ocr_classes: χ read for κ (καιρῷ, κατὰ, ἀναγκάζεσθαι, προκεκήρυκται, ἤκουον, κεφαλάς ...)
δ or θ read for β (ἀσεβῆ, εὐσεβούντων, σέβομαι, εὐσεβεῖς, Λιβεριανῷ/Λιβεριανός, ἀναβαίνειν, φοβερωτέρου, λαβόντες ...)
γ read for ν (Ἰουστῖνος, Ἰουστίνου, πάντα, ἐκείνου, γονέων, τινὸς, νομίζω, οὐρανὸν ...)
ε read for final ι (ἀρέσκωσι, παραγίνεσθαι, προσταχθεῖσιν, εἶξαι, βασιλεῦσιν)
λ read as « 1, .1 or ι (λόγους, λέγειν, λόγιος, ἄλλην, ἐλήλυθα, βουληθέντες ...)
rough and smooth breathing and acute/circumflex confused (αὐτούς, αὐτοῦ, αὐτῷ, αὐτῆς, αὐτὸν; εἰμι for the enclitic 'I am', εἶ 'you are')

judgments.note: shared OCR error in both Migne scans; the print reads ὅτι
participle; grave read as circumflex by OCR
the only departure from Migne's print: ἀφικεῖσθαι is a misprint (no such form); G and K agree on ἀφικνεῖσθαι
Migne's spelling kept; G's apparatus confirms it as the manuscript reading
closing bracket read as ὴ in both OCRs
also the lemma of Migne's note (77)
rough breathing is a shared OCR error

edition_differences.migne: ΙΟΥΣΤΙΝΟΥ ΧΑΡΙΤΩΝΟΣ, ΧΑΡΙΤΟΥΣ, ΠΑΙΩΝΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΙΒΕΡΙΑΝΟΥ (Euelpistus and Hierax not named)
five chapters: I Ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ... II Ποῦ συνέρχεσθε ... III Charito ... IV Ἄκουε ... V the sentence and death
edition_differences.G: six chapters (Ὧν εἰσαχθέντων opens II; Migne's V = V.8 and VI)

edition_differences.kept: Ἐπὶ as printed; translators should note the sense ἐπεί ('since') that the note, G and K give

edition_differences.migne: καὶ οὐ γινώσκω (note 72: Delenda videtur prima vocula)

edition_differences.kept: Migne's comma (image); the clause is a question

edition_differences.migne: ἕξειν αὐτοῦ τὰ δόγματα (note 78 suggests δόματα)
edition_differences.G: δώματα (conjecture; apparatus: δόγματα codd., δόματα O.)
edition_differences.kept: δόγματα (Migne, the manuscript reading per G's apparatus)

edition_differences.migne: Οὐδεὶς εὐφρονῶν ἀπὸ εὐσεβείας ἀσεβείᾳ εἰσπίπτει
edition_differences.G: Οὐδεὶς εὖ φρονῶν ἀπὸ εὐσεβείας εἰς ἀσέβειαν μεταπίπτει
edition_differences.kept: Migne (both scans, image, and the lemma of note 79 Εὐφρονῶν)
αὑτῶν as both OCRs read it; the breathing on the image is unclear (see uncertain)

edition_differences.migne: no movable ν before consonants (εἶπε, ἐστι, ἀληθέσι, πᾶσι)
edition_differences.K: adds movable ν (εἶπεν, ἐστιν, ἀληθέσιν, πᾶσιν)

uncertain.why: both Migne OCRs read the rough breathing and the mark on the scan looks unlike the smooth breathing of the nearby αὐτῶν/αὐτοῖς, but the print is too coarse to be sure; G has αὐτῶν. The sense ('their') is the same either way.

assembly.single_edition_readings: Readings attested only by Migne's print (both scans agree; G and K differ as editions): the title without Euelpistus and Hierax, Ἐπὶ, Ποῦ συνέρχεσθε with a comma, Χαρίτων, Χαριτώ, πρὸς Ἰουστῖνον (ch. 4), δόγματα, εὐφρονῶν ... ἀσεβείᾳ εἰσπίπτει, αὑτῶν. All other words have Migne plus G or K, or G plus K (ἀφικνεῖσθαι).

word_level_settlements.note: every adopted word where either Migne OCR differs from it (letters, accents or breathings), with the reading of each witness (M1, M2, G, K); all were checked on the scan B page images
